text:
Maria G: heads-up — planning a quiet-window swap of the autoscale policy for the silverline GPU pool tonight at 23:45 UTC. Target: move from reactive-2s -> predictive-1. Can @Ajay K and @Ciara T confirm preflight smoke + rollback readiness?

Ajay K: I can take smoke checks. What slice are we swapping first?

Maria G: start with slice-s14 (10% of capacity) as a canary for 15m. If healthy, proceed to s15 and s16 in 10m intervals.

Ciara T: +1. Preflight checklist posted below. Will validate allocator spread and eviction thresholds before cutover.

Ciara T: Preflight steps:
1) run `./scripts/pool-health.sh silverline` -> expect all nodes Ready
2) check evictions: `gcloud compute instances list --filter='labels:gpu_pool=silverline'`
3) ensure autoscaler config diff: `terraform plan -target=module.autoscaler`
4) create canary route: `kubectl apply -f canary-route-s14.yaml`

Ben L: Who's actually triggering the pipeline? I can be on standby for rollback.

Maria G: I'll trigger the deploy via CI (pipeline: infra/autoscale-swap). Ben please have rollback playbook ready. Ajay — will you monitor latency P50/P95 and GPU utilization?

Ajay K: Yep. I'll watch these metrics (Grafana dashboards):
- `silverline.p50_latency`
- `silverline.p95_latency`
- `gpu.utilization.per_node`
- `autoscale.scale_events`
Targets: p95 < 350ms, no >10% unexplained error rate, utilization change < 15% sustained.

Ciara T: Also watch for KV cache miss spikes (model-serving cache). If we see >30% miss rate for 5m, abort.

Maria G: Good call. Rollback command (if triggered):
1) cancel CI deployment -> `ci cancel <run-id>`
2) terraform apply previous autoscaler state: `terraform apply -var-file=autoscale-prev.tfvars`
3) remove canary route: `kubectl delete -f canary-route-s14.yaml`

deploy-bot: [schedule] Deployment scheduled by Maria G for 2026-08-15T23:45:00Z (pipeline infra/autoscale-swap). Run ID: 78912.

Ben L: I'll open a pager rotation for 30m post-cutover. Keep me posted in this thread.

Ajay K: Starting baseline capture now (30m) and will post a summary 10m before cutover.

Maria G: TL;DR: canary s14 23:45 UTC, 15m, monitored metrics thresholds as above, rollback plan = terraform revert + remove canary. Ping here once CI run starts.

deploy-bot: [start] Pipeline infra/autoscale-swap run 78912 triggered by Maria G at 1759943500.

Ajay K: canary slice applied at 1759943600. Observing: p50 steady, p95 +10ms, gpu util +2%. No errors.

Ciara T: allocator spread looks fine. No eviction events. KV miss stable.

Ben L: stand-by still.

Maria G: proceeding to scale s15 now (10m).

Ajay K: s15 ok at 1759944100. p95 still within threshold. No anomalies.

deploy-bot: [success] Pipeline infra/autoscale-swap run 78912 completed at 1759944125. Changes applied to silverline pool autoscaler.

Maria G: thanks all. I'll post the after-action notes tomorrow with the terraform diff and perf graphs. If anyone sees anything odd overnight ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
